# FAQ

#### Why zero external dependencies?

Each format is implemented from the byte layout up (branch-free inner loops, 64-byte-aligned buffers, LSB-first validity bitmaps), so kernels stay #![no_std] and audit-surface minimal.

#### What are the four sovereign entrypoints?

admit / eval / commit / verify (A19), exposed through the cgap-ffi C-ABI cdylib.
